rows.note: This is the all-purpose word for the animal and for fish as food when the context is clear.

example.english: The fish is swimming in the fish tank.
example.jyutping: tiu4 jyu4 hai2 seoi2 gong1 jap6 min6 jau4 gan2

rows.note: This is the all-purpose choice for catching fish or other aquatic animals with a line or hook.

example.english: We fish in Sai Kung on Sundays.
example.traditional: 我哋星期日去西貢釣魚。
example.jyutping: ngo5 dei6 sing1 kei4 jat6 heoi3 sai1 gung3 diu3 jyu4

rows.note: Use this when searching among other things to find or get hold of something.

example.english: I fish through my bag for my Octopus card.
example.traditional: 我喺個袋入面搵張八達通。
example.jyutping: ngo5 hai2 go3 doi6 jap6 min6 wan2 zoeng1 baat3 daat6 tung1

rows.note: Use this when trying to draw information out of someone indirectly or by questioning.

example.english: I fish for information by asking whether he knows the inside story.
example.traditional: 我試吓套料，睇吓佢係咪知內情。
example.jyutping: ngo5 si3 haa5 tou3 liu2 tai2 haa5 keoi5 hai6 mai6 zi1 noi6 cing4

rows.note: Use this when you specifically mean the flesh of a fish as food rather than the whole animal.

example.english: This dish is made with fresh fish flesh, and it tastes tender.
example.traditional: 呢道菜用新鮮魚肉整，食落好嫩。
example.jyutping: ni1 dou6 coi3 jung6 san1 sin1 jyu4 juk6 zing2 sik6 lok6 hou2 nyun6
